title: What Dataflow Programming 2.0 Is
definition: Dataflow Programming 2.0: programs as flowing data graphs.
description:
Dataflow Programming 2.0 is programs as flowing data graphs. It sits squarely in Future Software Paradigms, the frontier where flow runtimes science becomes program logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are streaming state-scale. Societies that master program hulls early will shape backpressure practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. title: Dataflow Programming 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Dataflow Programming 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Dataflow Programming 2.0 — programs as flowing data graphs.

Phase 1 — Prove (flow runtimes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (backpressure): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (streaming state): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and data engineering-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
